text:
Challenge the **onboarding load** first.

- It is an Olumi estimate: **4 experienced developer-hours/week**, with no source recorded.
- It directly reduces delivery capacity, and two hires may create a larger and longer diversion than a tech lead.
- Over only six months, the onboarding ramp can outweigh headcount gains; the relevant test is hours per week **and duration**, by hire type.

No model change or re-run has been made.
